name: Claims Triage Orchestrator
description: Triages one insurance claim: reads the claim record, delegates adjuster-note review and coverage/exclusions lookup to specialist workers, and returns a verdict (approved | partial | denied) with the payable amount and the exclusion or limit applied.

claimsBearer.description: Token must carry scope claims:triage; adjuster notes are read with the orchestrator's own scoped credentials, never the caller's.

skills.name: Triage a claim
skills.description: Given a claim id, decide approved / partial / denied and the payable amount, citing the exclusion or sub-limit applied. Pauses in input-required if a dependency needed for the decision (e.g. the exclusions service) is unavailable.
